sentences.text: Balwan S/o Ramsingh, Aged About 23 Years, R/o Aminpur
Urif Nayagaon, P.s. Bapcha Dist. Baran (Rajasthan)

(Accused Petitioner Is In Judicial Custody At District Jail  Baran, Dist. Baran)
2. Chhotulal Urif Ravindra S/o Babulal, Aged About 25 Years,
 R/o Sunda P.s . Fathegarh Dist. Guna (Mp) (Accused  Petitioner Is In Judicial Custody At District Jail Baran,
 Dist. Baran)
 ----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sumer Chand Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Meena, PP  Mr. Gajveer Singh Rajawat  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR UPMAN  Order 18/08/2023 1.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the petitioners under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., who have been arrested in connection with FIR No.218/2022 registered at Police Station Bapcha, District Baran for the offences under Sections 354, 506 & 34 of IPC.
Later on, the police filed the chargesheet in this matter for the offences under Sections 354, 506, 376D, 376(2)(n) & 34 of IPC and Sections 5G, 5L, 6, 16 & 17 of POCSO Act.
2. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioners that the accused-petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.

He submits that the FIR was registered on the basis of written (2 of 3)
[CRLMB-608/2023] report submitted by the prosecutrix, who is aged about 19 years but no allegation of rape was mentioned in the written report.

He further submits allegation of rape has been levelled against the petitioners in the statement recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C.,
wherein it has been mentioned by the prosecutrix that she was raped by the petitioners six months Balwan S/O Ramsingh vs State Of Rajasthan on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196278447/
1

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that petitioners are in custody since 07.12.2022 and chargesheet has been filed in this matter and trial of the case will take considerable time.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor assisted by learned counsel for the complainant opposes the bail application and submits that in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.,
there is allegation against the petitioners of committing rape upon prosecutrix.

5. Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case; considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and especially the fact that FIR has been registered on the basis of written report submitted by prosecutrix, who is aged about 19 years, in which she has not mentioned any fact regarding commission of rape and that chargesheet has been filed in this case as well as looking to the custody period of the petitioners, but without commenting anything on merits and demerits of the case, I deem it proper to allow the bail application.

6. This bail application is accordingly allowed and it is directed that accused-petitioners -(1) Balwan S/o Ramsingh (3 of 3) [CRLMB-608/2023] (2) Chhotulal Urif Ravindra S/o Babulal, shall be released on bail provided each of them furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) each to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court with the stipulation that they shall appear before that Court and any court to which the matter is transferred, on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J 18-Nirmala Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
